rca of the issue: Wallet null-deref: initial React state `wallet=null` from `useState(null)`. The main list correctly used optional chaining `(wallet?.transactions || [])` BUT the LoadMore sibling line read `wallet.transactions.length` without the `?.`. On first paint (before api.get('/wallet') resolves) wallet is null → TypeError → ErrorBoundary showed fallback. Reproduction: hit /wallet with cleared cache. Mitigation: added `?.` chain to the LoadMore condition. Permanent fix recommendation: initialize `useState({transactions:[], balance:0, packages:[]})` or render a skeleton guard early return `if (!wallet) return <Skeleton/>;` at top of component.
